newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance sets 1:1 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance sets 1:1 bonus issue.

text.p: Indian petrochemicals giant Reliance Industries Ltd said on Thursday it set a bonus equity issue in the ratio of one share for every share held.

"My dear shareholders I'm delighted to report to you ...my board has recommended a bonus issue in the ratio of one-for-one," chairman Dhirubhai Ambani told shareholders at the firm's annual general meeting (AGM).
The AGM was temporarily adjourned to enable the board to finalise the bonus ratio. Most shareholders had earlier requested a bonus of one-for-one.
The Reliance share jumped 15.5 rupees, or 4.3 percent, to 382 at the Bombay Stock Exchange after the bonus was announced.
